result.summary: This clip shows two distinct passages of play. The first involves a team in white building up from the back, with some off-ball movement and a shot on goal. The second passage shows a team in white defending and then attempting to build up, with a focus on wide play.

observations.title: Build-up from the back
observations.body: The team in white attempts to build play from their defensive third. They use short passes to move the ball through the central midfield.

observations.title: Central forward drops deep
observations.body: A player in a white kit, playing as a central forward, drops deep towards the midfield line. This movement creates space in behind the opposition's defensive line.

observations.title: Opposition pressing
observations.body: The team in blue applies pressure in the midfield, attempting to win the ball back. They are compact and force the white team to play quickly.

observations.title: Shot on goal
observations.body: A player in white receives the ball in a central attacking position and takes a shot towards the goal. The shot goes wide of the target.

observations.title: Defensive positioning
observations.body: The team in white is positioned in a defensive shape, with players tracking back. They are covering central areas, forcing the opposition wide.

observations.title: Wide player receives ball
observations.body: A player in white on the right wing receives the ball. They are isolated with an opponent, looking to drive forward.

observations.title: Lack of support for wide player
observations.body: The wide player in white receives the ball but has limited immediate support from teammates. This makes it difficult to progress the attack.

observations.title: Central forward checks back
observations.body: A player in a white kit, playing as a central forward, checks back towards the ball to offer a passing option. This is a similar movement to the one observed earlier in the clip.
